name: PNGS Gargi Fashion Jewellery Ltd
title: PNGS Gargi Fashion Jewellery Ltd - 543709 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Fashion jewellery retailer grows stores fast (32 added in FY26, 126 touchpoints) with zero debt and ~INR78 cr cash; capital-light FOCO model, guides ~35% revenue CAGR but supply signals are retail expansion, not industry capacity.

capex.quote: we are targeting additional at least 20 new stores in FY '27

triggers.label: Stores added 32 in FY26, 18 in Q4
triggers.quote: adding 32 new locations, including 18 store additions in Q4 alone

triggers.label: Targets at least 20 stores in FY27
triggers.quote: we are targeting additional at least 20 new stores in FY '27

triggers.label: Breakeven 15-18 months outside Maharashtra
triggers.quote: outside Maharashtra, as I said, 15 to 18 months are required to achieve that breakeven point

guidance.quote: targeting a CAGR of approximately 35% over the next few years
we are targeting additional at least 20 new stores in FY '27

guidance.value: same range in FY27-FY28, possibly 100-150bp higher
guidance.quote: Should remain in the same range.

red_flags.quote: It is around about 75% to 80% is coming from the SIS
